versions.changelog: Now covers all three resource types: x402 paid services, MCP servers, and A2A agents. New tools: search_mcp_servers, get_mcp_server, search_agents, get_agent, search_all, stats.
Update source repo link to AgentTools-Cloud org (monorepo)

Initial release of agent-tools-cloud:  
- Discover and call 2000+ paid APIs (token signals, on-chain Q&A, DeFi plans, LLM chat, etc.) from the x402 ecosystem via the agent-tools.cloud directory.
- No signup or API keys required; APIs are paid per call in USDC on Base.
- Four main tools: `search(intent)`, `get(slug)`, `list_categories()`, and `stats()`.
- Free to use for searching and viewing APIs; only underlying services charge per call.
- Full control over payment—agent only discovers and returns call templates; never auto-pays.
